messages:
maria: quick async standup — what I did: completed the probe script for AZ headroom, found a weird 10% shortfall in eu-west1 prewarm buckets. attached logs in the ticket.
alan: saw that, thanks. can you paste the probe command you ran? want to reproduce locally.
maria: yeah, ran: `redwoodctl fleet probe --region=eu-west1 --windows=5m --threshold=0.8` — output showed steady drop when spot reclaim > 3/min.
jing: FYI I opened a quota request with cloud for an emergency bump (case #CZ-1122). they said 24-48h but flagged urgent. added the case link.
sre-jen: quick heads-up — because of the spot behavior, recommended fallback is to temporarily route tiling workloads to dedicated lanes. that avoids cache thrash.
leo: can we do a fast canary within the same cluster? i.e., route 10% of traffic to dedicated for 1 hour and watch lat spikes.
maria: yes, i can push a canary. plan: create a route rule that sends tag=prewarm to dedicated-pool-3, duration 1h. will monitor cost and latency.
alan: if you're toggling routes, pls add a short-lived alert for queue backlog > 50ms p99 so we can roll back quick.
maria: good call. will add alert and post the link here when ready.
ops-bot: deploy started by maria: `canary-route create --src=tilt-prewarm --dst=dedicated-pool-3 --pct=10 --duration=1h` — status: queued.
jing: blocker: we still need IAM permission for the dedicated pool toggle in prod for the deploy role. can someone from infra grant `fleet.routes.update` to the release-bot until 1800 UTC?
sre-jen: i'm on it, granted for the release-bot until 1800 UTC. :white_check_mark:
maria: canary pushed, monitoring consoles: http://dashboards.internal/repl/fleet-prewarm (sharing view-only link)
leo: seeing a small uptick in token latency at 2m mark but within SLO. feel free to increase to 20% if you want more signal.
maria: holding at 10% for now. next steps after 30m: if stable, bump to 20% for another 30m, then decide to keep or rollback.
alan: small nit: add a short comment in the canary config referencing the quota case #CZ-1122 so audit logs have context.
maria: done.
jing: once we have the quota bump, we should deprovision the temporary dedicated instances to avoid extra cost. adding task to ops backlog.
leo: thanks team. if anything spikes or the alert fires, ping @sre-jen and @alan. otherwise i'll follow up in 50m with a summary.
maria: thanks all — no other blockers from me right now. :rocket:
